name: Protagonist
source:
In many ways, your typical high school student. Prior to joining the Literature Club, he was pretty lonely and shut in - indulging in video games and anime. Imbued with a snarky, dry sense of humour, the protagonist may be a little dense and naive, but his heart's always in the right place.

[Edited from the [url=https://blueskiesmod.club/characters.html]official website[/url]]
